verdict.rationale: Veriff supports webhook-driven, event-based automation (decision webhooks fire automatically after processing, event webhooks report progress, watchlist screening webhooks) and API session polling, which enable background processing without manual intervention. However, there is no evidence of AI-native agent orchestration, scheduled/triggered automations, or an agent framework — this is standard webhook/API integration, not agentic automation tooling. Missing for 10: AI-agent-specific automation/orchestration features, scheduling or trigger-based workflow builders, and any evidence of autonomous decision-making beyond fixed webhook callbacks.
